limitations: Only the selected frozen-influence endpoint and local branch are tested. No aerodynamic validation or archived K/F recovery is established.
Pointwise mesh differences are reported directly; no Richardson order, extrapolated answer or unproved monotonic convergence is inferred.
Refined saved sensor_airflow was not generated with posed sensor locations; no refined full local sensor alpha/speed claim is made.
Timing is native reduced-reference work including postprocessing, under contemporaneous tasks. It is not a controlled performance benchmark.

fixed_pose_diagnostic.qualification: Uses captured production residual and analytic Jacobian, not an independent aerodynamic model. No400 hinge root or physical mesh convergence follows from this fixed-pose correction.

aerodynamic_assumptions: Incompressible inviscid potential flow, prescribed rigid flat patch geometry, no empirical tuning.
Quarter-panel leading ring edge, full panel side displacement, 3/4-panel collocation, same-strength TE horseshoe with rear bound-edge cancellation.
Explicit caller-selected straight semi-infinite wake direction; no roll-up or free wake.
Zero core and no near-distance cutoff; true represented collinear segment/ray hits reject.
Canonical edges combine signed incident ring circulation. Own straight finite-edge midpoint contribution has symmetric principal value zero. Other collisions reject.
Steady Lambert2017 Eq4 full-vector midpoint loads and midpoint moment arms. No literal Healy Eq3.78 force replication claim.
No stall, compressibility, profile drag, section moment or original5.7897 slope correction. No dynamic or Gamma-dot load term.

independent_sources: Raw logical directed incidence reconstruction and scalar force/moment arithmetic
controls.interpretation: These are mixed analytic, algebraic identity, rejection and numerical refinement assertions, not105 independent physical benchmarks.

independent_finite_chord_reference.controls_interpretation: These are mixed analytic, algebraic identity, rejection and numerical refinement assertions, not105 independent physical benchmarks.

geometry.connectivity: explicit logical span-boundary joins required for multi-patch force graph; no coordinate hashing

geometry.hinge_axes: primary30 exact or normalized literal30 supplied explicitly

implementation_review_limitations: No hinge equilibrium, folded-wing load sweep, branch stability or experimental/archived accuracy acceptance is certified.
Boundary folded samples remain0,+20,-20degrees. Folded load coverage is a random-circulation canonical edge/ring velocity identity, not a solved folded load case.
The force law is separately sourced from Lambert2017Eq4 and is explicitly not literal HealyEq3.78 replication. No recovered Healy pressure distribution is claimed.
Near-wake collisions and extreme scales remain outside these controls; zero-core singularities must remain failures, not be hidden by this reference.

Flat chord/span refinement and small-angle slope stabilization have no independent finite-wing accuracy threshold. Trefftz-plane force quadrature, thin-plate quarter-chord moment convergence, rigid-transform covariance and nonzero-sideslip folded controls remain useful before stronger accuracy claims.
Source graph input validation assumes the declared structured uniform/affine geometry and ordering. This review does not approve arbitrary nonuniform/malformed grids.

The dimensional residual gate and normwise backward error control equation satisfaction, not forward circulation error or conditioning. Extreme overflow/nonfinite arithmetic is not an exercised control.

Canonical edge aggregation yields consistent global loads. Any later patch/hinge torque allocation must preserve moments; shared hinge-line forces have zero torque about that same hinge axis but do not define a unique local pressure map.
2pi versus archive5.7897, incompressible versus PG flow, wake/core, stall, viscosity and datum differences remain explicit and unfitted.

remaining: Producing model, constraints, atmosphere, freeze setting and circulation-mode count of the archived ASWING curves remain unproven.
The updated-influence curve is incomplete; the frozen curve is conditional and retains force/moment/local-angle differences.

Three finite-chord nominal roots do not establish a mesh-converged hinge angle or exact ASWING/Healy parity.
The force closure, half-chord datum, zero-core prescribed wake, section slope, compressibility, stall and drag differences remain explicit and unfitted.
Matched experimental setup, uncertainty, branch selection, dynamic stability and response remain open.
Full historical FFWT study packaging and further independent aerodynamic accuracy controls remain separate.

separate_primary_curve.comparison_policy: All original XY strings/order retained. Digitized X, nominal protocol X and archived requested alpha remain distinct; no interpolation, fitting, extrapolation, pairing or fold-to-bank conversion is performed.

observable.definition: Equilibrium hinge fold angle, measured by hinge rotary encoder; zero is the unfolded hinge reference (coplanar tip/inner wing for the untwisted configuration).
observable.explanation: Encoder hinge angle is not generally the same as an Euler bank/roll angle of a sensor frame at finite flare/fold. The archived Var5 sign choice alone does not resolve this mismatch.
observable.quantity: Port equilibrium hinge fold angle measured by rotary encoder
